decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cutting and creasing finisher already given its own product page, we would keep it because it fits our established portfolio and any slow uptake can still be read as a normal ramp-up period.
Despite being farther from our traditional offer, we would keep it because we launched it very publicly as a flagship with a Germany premiere, making a quick withdrawal hard to justify.
We would keep this sheet preparation module because it builds directly on our modular automation offer and there is no clear sign that any weak traction is more than temporary.
We would keep this B2-format multifinisher because it is close to our core business and was publicly presented as a strategic flagship, which creates especially strong commitment.
We would keep the hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends our established booklet-making range and dropping it quickly would squander recent launch investment in a growing market.
We would keep the folding add-on because it complements existing equipment and already has a named customer use case, supporting continued commitment rather than exit.
